entities.summary: Mason Lohrei is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played college ice hockey for Ohio State University in the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). He is the first player in NHL history to have been born in the state of Louisiana.
